title: BPW-2026-0544
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0544
BOE + BSS
CD 14
REVOCABLE PERMISSION TO ENCROACH INTO THE PUBLIC WAY – 3703 NORTH HELLMAN AVENUE
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue a Revocable Permit (R-Permit) to encroach within the public way, subject to the conditions listed. Encroachments:
• Portion of an existing garage encroaching up to 14 feet and 7 inches on Cassatt Street
• Existing variable height stone retaining wall
• Existing concrete steps and gates on Cassatt Street and Hellman Avenue
• Existing variable height retaining wall with wrought-iron fence
• Existing walkway brick pavers
• Existing landscaping
Conditions:
The property owner(s) shall execute the attached Waiver of Damages agreement and submit the notarized copy to the Bureau of Engineering (BOE), Central District, 201 N. Figueroa Street, 3rd Floor, R-Permit Counter, for review prior to recording with the County Recorder.
The property owner(s) shall provide liability and property damage insurance satisfactory to the City Attorney for coverage in the amount of at least $300,000. Evidence of insurance must be presented annually to the Board.
The property owner(s) shall execute the attached Covenant and Agreement agreeing to remove all the encroachments in the public right-of-way at no cost if requested by the City of Los Angeles upon request within 90 days. The property owner shall submit the notarized copy electronically to the BOE R-Permit online application at
https://engpermits.lacity.org/rpermits
.
All construction and inspection on private property shall require applicable permits from the Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety (LADBS). The property owner(s) shall submit an electronic copy of the garage plan approved by the LADBS to the BOE R Permit online application at
https://engpermits.lacity.org/rpermits
.
The property owner(s) shall obtain a R-Permit from the BOE’s Central District Office, 201 N. Figueroa Street, 3rd Floor, R-Permit Counter, when Condition Nos. 1 through 4 have been satisfied.
The conditions herein must be accomplished, and the R-Permit issued within 24 months of notification of the approval of this report.
summary: The Board is asked to authorize a revocable permit that lets the property at 3703 North Hellman Avenue keep its garage, retaining walls, steps, gates and landscaping extending into the public right-of-way.
